journey.name: Image select — cover from web (Unsplash), gallery and a pasted address
journey.description:
Choosing a card/cover image: open the image sheet from the Publish cover, search the web grid, and select a photo. The web grid needs an Unsplash access key — either the user's own (Settings, see journey 16) or the build-time UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY fallback in local.properties. With neither, the grid area shows the "add a key" panel and the web steps should be skipped. The gallery path opens the system photo picker, which cannot be reliably automated, so it is left as a manual check. Requires a signed-in session (journey 01).
The sheet's one field is both the search box and the address box: text that parses as a link replaces the grid with a preview of that image, and Done stays disabled until the preview actually loads — the check that stops a copied *page* address being saved as a card face that can never render. The Paste button puts a copied address into that field. An image copied as *bytes* ("Copy image" in Chrome) is refused with a message for now — taking it is issue #168.
To prime the clipboard without a helper app: type the URL into `image_search_input`, select it with `adb shell input keycombination 113 29` and copy it with `113 31`, then clear the field with `image_link_clear` before testing Paste.

actions.action: Launch the Loopky app and verify the Home screen is shown
Tap the element with resource-id "tab_decks" in the bottom tab bar
Tap the element with resource-id "decks_paste_cta"
Type the following two lines into the field with resource-id "paste_input": "sol,sun", "luna,moon"
Tap the element with resource-id "paste_next"
Tap the element with resource-id "triage_keep" twice to keep both cards and advance to Publish
Tap the element with resource-id "publish_cover_change" to open the cover image sheet
Verify the image sheet shows a search field (resource-id: image_search_input), a "From gallery" button (resource-id: image_pick_gallery) and a "Paste" button (resource-id: image_paste)

If a key is configured: type "sun" into the field with resource-id "image_search_input", verify the web image grid (resource-id: image_grid) populates, tap the first cell (resource-id: image_grid_cell), then tap "Done" (resource-id: image_sheet_done) and verify the cover thumbnail updates on the Publish screen

Attribution (Unsplash API guidelines): with the grid populated, verify every visible cell shows the photographer's name over a gradient at its bottom edge, and that the credit line (resource-id: image_credit) below the grid reads "Photos from Unsplash" before a selection and "Photo by NAME on Unsplash" after one

Tap the photographer's name in the credit line and verify a browser opens their Unsplash profile with utm_source=loopky and utm_medium=referral in the URL; go back and tap "Unsplash" in the same line to verify it opens unsplash.com with the same params

If no key is configured: verify the grid area shows the panel with resource-id "image_sheet_key_panel" rather than the grid, that no credit line is shown, and skip the web selection steps — the key path itself is covered by journey 16

Link — a typed address: reopen the sheet with "publish_cover_change" and type "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1574158622682-e40e69881006?w=600" into "image_search_input". Verify the grid is replaced by the preview (resource-id: image_link_preview), the credit line disappears (nothing on screen is an Unsplash photo any more), and Done becomes enabled once the image is drawn. Tap "image_sheet_done" and verify the cover updates.

Link — Done is gated on the preview: reopen the sheet and type "https://example.com/not-an-image" into "image_search_input". Verify the preview area shows the failure text (resource-id: image_link_error) and that "image_sheet_done" stays DISABLED — a link that will not render here must never be saved onto a card.
Link — clearing: with a link in the field, tap "image_link_clear" and verify the field empties, the preview goes away and the Unsplash grid (or the key panel) comes back.
Paste — an address on the clipboard: with an image URL copied, tap "image_paste" and verify the address lands in the field and previews as the image, exactly as typing it does.
Paste — plain text on the clipboard: copy a word, tap "image_paste", and verify it stays a search term — the grid keeps its place and no preview appears.

Paste — a Google Images result address: open Chrome, search Google Images for "sunflower", long-press a result and choose "Copy image address"; back in the sheet, tap "image_paste". If Chrome hands over a "google.com/imgres?imgurl=…" viewer address, this is the case the parser unwraps: it must preview the image itself, NOT fail.

Paste — an image copied as bytes: in Chrome, long-press an image and choose "Copy image", then tap "image_paste". Verify the sheet says so in one line (resource-id: image_sheet_notice) and points at the address and the gallery, and — the actual regression guard — that the app stays responsive: reading such a clip through the provider is what froze it (issue #168).
Paste — nothing usable: clear the clipboard (a fresh emulator boot) and tap "image_paste". Verify the sheet reports it in one line (resource-id: image_sheet_notice) rather than doing nothing.
The same field/Paste/preview behaviour must hold in the card image sheets, which are the same composable: check one of them via "triage_edit" → "triage_edit_front_image_add"

A pick belongs to the sheet that made it: in "triage_edit", set a front image (any source) and commit it, then open the BACK sheet with "triage_edit_back_image_add". The field must be empty, no "image_link_preview" may be showing, the grid and credit line must be back, and "image_sheet_done" must be DISABLED. The ViewModel is the screen's, not the sheet's, so a regression here is one tap of Done away from putting the front's picture on the back without anyone choosing it.
Manual check (system picker not automatable): tap "From gallery" (resource-id: image_pick_gallery), choose an image, and verify it is compressed and shown as the cover
